notes: Stories reviewed. No gaps or duplicates identified. Coverage includes schema, core logic, integration, API exposure, and testing.

MAINT-DIST-S1.title: Define Distance Calculation Schema and Contract
MAINT-DIST-S1.description: Define standardized input/output schema for distance calculation including coordinates (lat/long), units (miles/km), and response fields (distance, duration if available, status). Ensure compatibility with existing Google Routes response patterns.

MAINT-DIST-S2.title: Implement Core Distance Calculation Logic
MAINT-DIST-S2.description: Implement backend service to compute distance between two coordinate pairs using existing Google Routes integration logic or fallback calculation if unavailable. Normalize output to the defined schema.

MAINT-DIST-S3.title: Integrate Distance Logic into Domain Services
MAINT-DIST-S3.description: Integrate distance calculation into relevant domain services (e.g., clinical trials and provider workflows) so distance is computed consistently and reused rather than duplicated.

MAINT-DIST-S4.title: Distance Calculation Unit and Integration Tests
MAINT-DIST-S4.description: Create unit tests for distance calculations (valid coordinates, edge cases, invalid inputs) and integration tests validating end-to-end behavior within clinical trials and provider search flows.

MAINT-DIST-S5.title: Expose Distance Calculation via Internal API/Facade
MAINT-DIST-S5.description: Expose distance computation through application layer (facade or tool) so other services and chat flows can request distance consistently. Ensure alignment with existing tool_router patterns and response formats.
